query: 灵活工作安排 灵活工作安排 衡量企业在远程/弹性办公方面的制度与执行。 一、 内容质量得分 (权重 50%) 衡量制度的专业性与可执行度，防止“口头承诺”而无制度保障。 2分：卓越（三要素齐全） 制度清晰： 明确定义了弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时（如 4.5 天工作制）的具体形式，针对特殊员工群体有单独的配套措施。 适用边界： 清楚界定了哪些岗位适用、申请流程及审批权限，具有极强的操作性。 绩效协同： 建立了“以结果为导向”的考核机制，确保灵活办公不影响协作效率（如配套的线上协作工具、核心协作时间规定）。 1分：合格 包含一个或两个 0分：缺失 未披露任何相关信息，或企业文化明确强调全员必须现场打卡且无弹性空间。 二、 覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%,) 衡量制度的穿透力，即多少员工真正受益。 2分：全覆盖与高穿透 覆盖率： 机制覆盖 100% 符合岗位性质的员工（如非生产一线人员全覆盖）。 执行数据： 披露了实际使用灵活办公人数占符合条件人数的比例。 满意度： 披露了针对灵活办公效果的员工满意度调研结果。 1分：合格 提及个别案例或极少数特殊岗位（如孕期员工）可申请。 0分：不满足/无数据 无法证明制度已在实际中得到应用。 灵活工作安排 弹性工时 远程办公 混合办公 居家办公 压缩工时 核心协作时间 弹性工作制度 WFH hybrid work flexible working flexible working hours remote work hybrid work work from home compressed workweek core collaboration hours flexible work arrangement WFH 企业是否定义弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时等具体形式？ 适用岗位、申请流程与审批权限是否明确？ 是否建立结果导向考核或核心协作时间等配套？ 披露了多少符合条件员工实际使用灵活办公？ 是否有相关满意度结果？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '灵活工作安排'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否定义弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时等具体形式？ 适用岗位、申请流程与审批权限是否明确？ 是否建立结果导向考核或核心协作时间等配套？ 披露了多少符合条件员工实际使用灵活办公？ 是否有相关满意度结果？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有加班管理；仅有育儿假/产假制度；仅有居家办公临时防疫安排；仅有企业文化宣传无制度；区分：灵活工作安排关注远程/弹性办公制度与执行；反歧视政策关注禁止歧视；平等机会措施关注招聘晋升选拔公平流程，三者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: When the pandemic broke out in early 2020, both our teams in Singapore and China were quick to respond. Office guidelines on safety management procedures (in alignment with government-mandated measures) were issued to all staff. The procedures implemented included daily office disinfection and temperature taking exercises and hybrid work arrangements implemented to prevent overcrowding alongside with mandatory mask-wearing. Furthermore, a mask donation drive was also conducted in the Suzhou office and items were distributed to the Cambodia office thereafter.

COVID-19 Impact: Providing masks to our employees

[Content]
When the pandemic broke out in early 2020, both our teams in Singapore and China were quick to respond. Office guidelines on safety management procedures (in alignment with government-mandated measures) were issued to all staff. The procedures implemented included daily office disinfection and temperature taking exercises and hybrid work arrangements implemented to prevent overcrowding alongside with mandatory mask-wearing. Furthermore, a mask donation drive was also conducted in the Suzhou office and items were distributed to the Cambodia office thereafter.

results.text: Additionally, safeguarding the health and safety of our stakeholders remained a core priority for Home Control, as we strove to maintain the highest standards of Occupational Health and Safety practices in compliance with local governments' and international health authorities' recommendations. results.text: Our operations in Singapore are governed by the Employment Act of 1968, and our operations in China (which include our China office and our main manufacturing partner in China) are governed by the Law of the People's Republic of China on Employment Contract. Under Article 15 of the Labour Law in China, it is illegal to hire employees under the age of 16. Under the Law of the Protection of Juveniles in Singapore, there are several work arrangement restrictions for employees aged 16 to 18 years old. As such, it is company policy not to hire employees under the age of 18.

results.text: Beyond replacing plastic packaging material with paper-based packaging certified by the Forest Stewardship Council, Home Control conducted an Ocean-Bound Plastic (OBP) study to explore other waste management effort that the company can adopt in reducing ocean plastic. Specifically, OBP aims to reduce involuntary littering by issuing certifications to organization for the collection or recycling of ocean plastic. A study was conducted for 2 OBP Resin from one of our local Vendors, Kingfa. With Kingfa being a key production side for Resin CK-150 and CK-250, Kingfa expressed its interest in adopting OBP waste management method. As such, a primary dry-run and reliability tests were conducted for CK-150 and CK-250. Home Control concluded that we will be working closely with UL to apply for the certification, which are ready November 2021.
